blocks.content: Puducherry's environment chapter is comparatively compact given its small, flat, coastal geography, but features a few specific, frequently tested wetland and sanctuary names.

cells: Near Puducherry town, on the Tamil Nadu border
A significant wetland and bird habitat, hosting numerous migratory and resident bird species; an important local biodiversity and eco-tourism site
Another significant wetland complex supporting local agriculture (irrigation tanks) and biodiversity
Estuarine/coastal wetland habitat associated with the Kaveri delta's Coleroon distributary
Backwater and estuarine habitat on the Godavari delta, distinct in character from the Puducherry/Karaikal Coromandel Coast wetlands

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Ousteri Lake (also spelt Oussudu) is Puducherry's most frequently tested wetland/bird-habitat site — remember it straddles the Puducherry-Tamil Nadu border near Puducherry town.

items: Puducherry's coastline faces significant coastal erosion challenges, particularly around Puducherry town's harbour/breakwater area, where engineering interventions over past decades have altered natural sediment (littoral drift) patterns along the coast, a widely studied case of human-infrastructure-induced coastal erosion in Indian coastal-management literature.

Auroville's afforestation and eco-restoration efforts (undertaken since the township's founding, transforming previously eroded, semi-arid land into significant forest cover) represent a notable and frequently cited example of successful community-led ecological restoration, adding to Auroville's significance beyond its spiritual/cultural role (Chapter 9).

Groundwater depletion and salinity intrusion, given Puducherry's small land area, coastal location and dense settlement pattern, are ongoing water-resource management concerns for the UT administration.
Ousteri (Oussudu) Lake near Puducherry town is the UT's most significant wetland/bird-habitat site.
Puducherry town's harbour/breakwater has caused notable coastal erosion, a widely studied case of infrastructure-induced erosion.
Auroville's community-led afforestation is a notable ecological-restoration success story.
